meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 代码审查时输出精简意见：每条问题一行，格式为「行号: 问题. 修法.」，多文件 diff 用「文件:行号」。可加 🔴 bug、🟡 risk、🔵 nit、❓ q 前缀。结果可直接粘贴进 PR。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-review，或说“review this PR”、“review the diff”时触发。遇到安全类问题、架构分歧或新人上手场景，会改用正常段落说明。

say.note: 逐条给出单行审查意见
多文件时每条带上文件名和行号
恢复成详细啰嗦的审查风格

howto.what_en: Turns code review into terse one-liners: location, problem, fix — e.g. L42: 🔴 bug: user can be null. Add guard. Optional severity prefixes (bug/risk/nit/q); file:line for multi-file diffs. Output is paste-ready for the PR.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff". Security findings, architectural disagreements, and new-author onboarding switch back to normal paragraphs.

say_en.note: Gives one terse line per finding.
Adds file:line when the diff spans files.
